meta.name: tech-debt-audit
meta.description: Thorough, file-cited technical debt audit across 9 dimensions using AST-grep (tree-sitter), grep, LSP, and language-native tooling. Produces TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with severity, effort estimates, and prioritized fixes. Use when asked for codebase health check, tech debt audit, architecture review, code quality assessment, or cleanup planning. Triggers: 'tech debt', 'technical debt', 'debt audit', 'code health', 'technical debt audit', 'codebase health check', 'find tech debt', 'debt analysis', 'audit code quality'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审计代码库九大维度,输出带优先级的技术债报告。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想动手重构前先摸清代码库里哪些地方最该修。
copy.tagline_en: Audit code on 9 dimensions and get a prioritized tech-debt report.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to know what to fix before refactoring.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按 9 个维度扫描代码库,每条问题都标出 file:line:col 引用,最后在仓库根目录写出 TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md,里面有发现表格、严重度分级、工时估算、Top 5 优先级和快速修复清单。
howto.when: 当你要求做代码库健康检查、技术债审计或架构审查,或提到 “tech debt”、“code health” 等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我审计这个代码库的技术债,结果写进 TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md
say.note: 会按 9 个维度扫描并生成报告

say.text: 审计 src 目录的架构和类型债,每条都标出文件:行号
say.note: 每处发现都带 file:line:col 引用

say.text: 最后列出 30 分钟内能改完的快速修复项
say.note: 报告本身含 Quick Wins 清单

howto.what_en: Claude scans the codebase across 9 dimensions, citing file:line:col for every finding, then writes TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with a findings table, severity levels, hour estimates, top 5 priorities, and a quick-wins checklist.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a codebase health check, a tech debt audit, or an architecture review, or mention 'tech debt', 'code health' and similar terms.

say_en.text: Audit this codebase for tech debt and write TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md
say_en.note: Runs a 9-dimension scan and writes the report.

say_en.text: Audit src/ for architecture and type debt, citing file:line:col
say_en.note: Each finding is grounded in a code citation.
